name: Adolf Hitler
title: Führer of Nazi Germany
quote: Success is the sole earthly judge of right and wrong.
bio: Rose to power following severe hyperinflation and economic collapse of the Weimar Republic. Established a totalitarian state and triggered WWII in Europe.

name: Benito Mussolini
title: Duce of Fascist Italy
quote: It is better to live one day as a lion than a hundred years as a sheep.
bio: Pioneered modern fascism after post-WWI economic turmoil in Italy. Invaded Ethiopia in 1935 and allied with Germany in WWII.

name: Joseph Stalin
title: General Secretary of Communist Party
quote: Ideas are far more powerful than guns. We don't allow our enemies to have guns, why should we allow them to have ideas?
bio: Led the Soviet Union through massive forced industrialization, collectivization, WWII Eastern Front battles, and established Soviet hegemony in Eastern Europe.

name: Winston Churchill
title: Prime Minister of United Kingdom
quote: We shall defend our island, whatever the cost may be. We shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight on the landing grounds, we shall never surrender.
bio: Rallied Allied resistance against Axis aggression during WWII, leading Britain through the Battle of Britain and key North African counter-offensives.

name: Franklin D. Roosevelt
title: 32nd President of United States
quote: The only thing we have to fear is fear itself.
bio: Guided the US through the Great Depression with the New Deal and mobilized American military power as key Allied leader during World War II.

name: Muammar Gaddafi
title: Brotherly Leader of Revolution
quote: I will not leave the country and will die as a martyr.
bio: Seized power in a 1969 military coup. Maintained total authority for 42 years until his regime collapsed during the 2011 Libyan Civil War.

name: Omar al-Bashir
title: President of Sudan
bio: Took power in a 1989 military coup. Governed during severe economic distress, decades of civil war in South Sudan and Darfur before being ousted in 2019.

name: Juvénal Habyarimana
title: President of Rwanda
quote: Peace and unity are the foundation of our nation.
bio: Seized power in 1973. Severe economic strains and coffee price crashes in the late 1980s triggered civil war, culminating in his assassination and the 1994 genocide.

name: Robert Mugabe
title: President of Zimbabwe
quote: The only white man you can trust is a dead white man, but let us be broad-minded.
bio: Liberation hero turned authoritarian leader. Hyperinflation and severe economic collapse in the 2000s led to political violence and systemic institutional crisis.
